join.speaker: Relc
join.text: Bones. Old fires, cold a long time. One way out and we're standing in it. Something's been living down here a good long while, and it just heard us walk in. Deep tunnels, huh? You know what lives in deep tunnels? Me. As of today. Come on. You swing, I'll skewer.

alone_confirm.speaker: Relc
alone_confirm.text: Alone? Ha! You're either very brave or very— actually, no. Just the one thing. I'll hang back at the mouth, then, and let the professional wait by the door for once. Shout if you find teeth. Shout before, ideally.
